name: bash
arguments:
{"command":"python - <<'PY'
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN
q=Decimal('16'); p=Decimal('11.51'); d=Decimal('0.0837'); t=Decimal('0.0673'); s=Decimal('53')
subtotal=q*p
net=subtotal*(1-d)
taxed=net*(1+t)
amount=taxed+s
print('subtotal',subtotal)
print('discounted',net)
print('taxed',taxed)
print('unrounded',amount)
print('rounded',amount.quantize(Decimal('0.01'),rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN))
PY"}
